articleTitle: Agreements and Disagreements in the Selection of Natural Esters for Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The “critical dielectric fluid,” or CDF, made of natural esters encourages the need for power transformers to meet CIGRE and IEEE requirements. The areas of dielectric qualities including dissipation factor, moisture, oxidative stability, and partial discharges are where there is the most dispute over the capabilities of the natural ester. Modified versions of natural esters are introduced into the systems to preserve the transformers' dependability since they decrease practical failure. Natural esters exhibit remarkable agreement with the solid insulation in terms of insulating life by lowering the formation of dissolved gases. This critical analysis was primarily designed to help the researcher comprehend the reasons behind the discrepancy in CDF choice about CDF's capacity to exhibit the characteristics of superior insulating commercial fluid (SICF).

articleTitle: Cluster Analysis in Insulating Fluids Using $k$-Means and Hierarchical Clustering Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The research looks at the relationships that each species group has with the other groupings. Pongamia Oil, Modified-Pongamia Oil, and Mineral Oil are the three types of oil employed in the research; they are referred to by their respective species designations (here, species=category), PO, MPO, and MO. Additionally, the group is described using four dielectric parameters, including breakdown voltage, kinematic viscosity, and dielectric constant, and moisture content. These values are abbreviated as BDV, KVIS, DC, and MC in that order. Using k-Means clustering, the data are split into k mutually exclusive clusters, with centroids connected to each cluster for rearranging. The sum of distances between the centroids and other data are reduced by the k-Means algorithm using Silhouette values. These additional data are given an object identifier that may be used to subsequently reorganize the cluster. While hierarchical clustering identifies the many levels of data categorization. The cophenetic correlation is used to confirm the consistency of the cluster tree's initial distances. Dendrogram plot is also used to show the hierarchy of clusters. These clusters demonstrate that there are at least two groups for each oil, and a detailed examination of the clusters will reveal the salient characteristics of the group that will affect its qualities.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Full-Subtractor Using 4 to 1 Line Multiplexer Based on Micro Ring Resonator Nonlinear Switching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This paper manifest a prominent method for designing full-subtractor using 4 to 1 line multiplexer based on all optical switching action of Micro Ring Resonator. Proposed theoretical model utilizes the feasible properties of MRR, which proves to be more efficient and effective to get the stable output. Here the switching activity of MRR in sync with the working of MUX in conjunction with the corresponding figure and graph are explained. Also the mathematical equation of the required MRR working operation has been discussed deeply. The MUX circuit design used here is formed by the network of MRRs cascaded together. To accomplish the output of full-subtracter, we considered ‘B’ as the data line and other two as the required select line. The validation of the logical output behavior of the implemented 4 to 1 line MUX was endorsed using simulation obtained from MATLAB.

articleTitle: Sensor Node-Based Smart Irrigation System with IoT Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Agricultural production constitutes the backbone of the Indian economy, so modernization is essential. The motivation for this paper comes from developing countries, much of which depend on agriculture and climate conditions. Internet of Things (IoT) technology is played a key role in overcoming the backwardness of traditional agriculture, improving crop production, preventing crop damage and efficiently using water. This paper proposes the deployment of a smart irrigation system based on portable prototypes using capacitive soil sensors based on qualitative designs and sensory data collection methods from agricultural fields. Sensors are connected to the Internet via wirelessly in this case. Through wireless sensor nodes, data from the sensors is sent to the cloud. The IoT frameworks analyze and process the collected data. This is followed by regular notifications being sent to the farmer's mobile phones or Application Programming Interfaces (API) application. Changing soil temperatures and moisture can be tracked by farmers. This can prevent unnecessary water waste. In this paper, we discuss various experiments conducted in this context and present a comparatively low-cost wireless irrigation system.

articleTitle: GWO-Based Workflow Scheduling in Cloud-Fog Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The scientific workflows are a set of predefined tasks aiming to achieve a target goal state. Cloud computing provides an appropriate environment for orchestrating such scientific workflows. However, scheduling these workflows in a cloud environment is a big challenge due to the high latency and connectivity on low bandwidth network infrastructure. Nowadays, fog and edge computing devices offer an alternative to cloud computing. As a result, these devices can provide cloud computing capabilities for processing scientific workflows near the source. This paper explores the possibilities of scheduling workflows on both cloud and fog computing devices. In order to schedule workflows on cloud-fog integrated devices, we implemented the Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) based algorithm using dynamic weights for updating the grey wolf position on the FogWorkflowSim simulator. The proposed scheme avoids getting into a local optimum and improves the performance of the QoS parameters. We also compare the outcomes of different scheduling algorithms in cloud and hybrid cloud-fog architectures. The simulation results of the proposed approach using well-known scientific workflows suggest that cloud-fog integration for workflow scheduling improves processing performance while reducing energy consumption and cost.

articleTitle: Detecting Hate Speech Utilizing Deep Convolutional Network and Transformer Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Online social networks exhibit a significant prevalence of hate speeches, which poses a potential threat to the society and fosters targeted animosity towards specific communities and authorities. Although online platforms are available to automate few mechanisms of hate speeches but classification w.r.t. to different domains and their accuracy are the big issues, and are challenging the researchers, media, and the academic world. The present study addresses the identifying of Hate Speeches through the comparative analysis of the classification efficacy and model intricacy of four distinct Deep Neural Network models; namely CNN (baseline), bidirectional LSTM with attention, pretrained BERT, and fine-tuned RoBERTa transformer models, and utilizing a ternary classification system (hate, offensive, non-hate). The performance of the subject under consideration was assessed through the application of Accuracy, F1-score, and Matthew's correlation coefficient (MCC) metrics on the test set.

articleTitle: Analytical Study of the Dual-Band Log-Periodic Antenna with MIMO Configuration for S-Band CubeSat Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The investigation of 3U CubeSat-based dual band Log-periodic antenna with multi-input-multi-output (MIMO) configuration for S-band application is proposed in this paper. This work focuses on the performance of antenna with the exploration of the possibility of MIMO configuration. The MIMO antenna design utilizes the concept of using two identical radiators fed in opposite directions to maintain the isolation. The degree of isolation observed between the ports remains below −40 dB within the desired frequency range. The antenna exhibits dual-band with operating center frequency at 2.3 GHz and 2.9 GHz for lower and upper bands, respectively. The design maintains a large frequency ratio of operation to be used for different satellite applications. Additionally, it offers a directivity of 8.592 dBi and an efficiency of 62 %. Further, MIMO performance matrices like mean effective gain (MEG), envelope correlation coefficient (ECC), total active reflection coefficient (TARC), and diversity gain (DG) are investigated. In addition, a systematic investigation is carried out to perform a parametric analysis with assess the sensitivity of the optimized dimensions in order to fine tune the proposed antenna response.

articleTitle: Hyper-Parameter Tuning with Grid and Randomized Search Techniques for Predictive Models of Hotel Booking
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The tourism and hospitality industries rely heavily on the hotel industry, making it crucial for hotels to optimize their business strategies. Predicting hotel bookings is one strategy that can enable hotel management to make informed decisions about pricing, marketing, and resource allocation. In this paper, we explore the use of machine learning algorithms to predict hotel bookings, focusing on two types of hotels, leisure and business hotels. We use a dataset from Kaggle containing information on hotel bookings, including 32 features such as hotel type, arrival date, departure date, and booking date. We pre-process the data by converting categorical variables into numerical variables, imputing missing values, and performing feature scaling. We evaluate various machine learning algorithms on the dataset, including Gradient Boosting Classifier, Random Forest Classifier, and Logistic Regression Classifier, using accuracy as the evaluation metric. Our results show that these three algorithms perform well on the given dataset, with the Gradient Boosting Classifier achieving the highest accuracy of 86.5%, followed by Random Forest Classifier with an accuracy of 85.2%, and Logistic Regression Classifier with an accuracy of 80.7%. Our findings demonstrate the potential of machine learning techniques in predicting hotel bookings and can be useful to hotel management in optimizing their business strategies.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigations to Enhance Precision and Accuracy in UAV Photogrammetry of 3D Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have become a popular tool for photogrammetry applications like mapping and 3D modeling. UAVs offer several advantages over traditional aerial photography, including low-cost, rapid deployment, and the ability to capture high-resolution imagery from unique angles and viewpoints. This paper studies UAV photogrammetry with technology and techniques used to capture, process, and analyze UAV imagery for mapping and 3D modeling applications. Based on the study, the importance of optimal flight planning, image processing, and data fusion techniques in improving the quality and accuracy of the data captured by UAVs is understood. The circular grid plays a vital role since it has better views when compared with rectangular grid so that while converting into 3D model, the object will be well defined.

articleTitle: Real-Time Facial Emotion Detection System Using Multimodal Fusion Deep Learning Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: One of the crucial applications in the area of computer vision is face emotion detection. Systems for detecting facial emotions are frequently utilized in fields of study such as the detection of human social and physiological interactions and the diagnosis of mental diseases. Identifying facial emotions with high accuracy is a challenging task. The capacity of the deep learning model to extract facial features from the input images determines how accurately emotions are detected. The deep learning model used in this work for emotion detection is the convolution and attention network (CoAtNet), which combines the convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with the vision transformers (ViTs). The FER2013 dataset is the one used for model training and validation. This work also includes training on various CNN models such as VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet121, and Xception. Among all the models, the CoAtNet model provided the highest validation accuracy of 80.314%. To improve accuracy, the facial landmarks of the images are extracted and incorporated into the deep learning network through the Multimodal Fusion approach. By incorporating the facial landmarks through multimodal fusion, the validation accuracies of the deep learning networks are improved, and the highest accuracy of 83.458% is obtained with the CoAtN et model. Using the CoAtNet model, a face emotion detection system is implemented on the Raspberry Pi hardware, which detects the emotion of a person by capturing real-time images.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive System Identification and Noise Filtering Using Bregman Divergence Based Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This article proffers a new set of least mean square (LMS) algorithms based on the Bregman divergence class of information-theoretic divergence, which are named as Kullback-Leibler LMS (KLLMS), Itakura-Saito LMS (ISLMS), and ßLMS. To achieve a tractable analysis, a bound on the learning rate of proffered algorithms is derived. Steady-state mean-square deviation (MSD) and computational cost provide insight into the performance and efficiency of the proffered algorithms in the presence of Gaussian and impulsive noise. Simulation results also show the effectiveness of the proffered algorithms in adaptive noise filtering.

articleTitle: Industry 4.0: IoT and Cloud Computing Enabled Smart Waste Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Waste management system is the practice of controlling garbage from the moment it is produced until its disposal. In other words it can be termed as a life cycle of garbage. The main objective behind waste management is to lessen the harmful effects of garbage on the environment and people's health. A substantial percentage of waste management is devoted to managing municipal solid waste, which is generated by business, residential, and industrial activity. Waste inevitably results from everything we undertake. As a result of the population expansion, waste management has evolved into one of the most difficult challenges facing our current generation. Overflowing trash cans are now a common sight; burning trash and dumping it outside has become a regular ritual. These factors have made a significant impact on the environment and the planet as a whole. In order to address this problem; we require an efficient and dynamic waste management system. In this research study, we presented a smart waste management system by integrating industry 4.0 enabled technologies such as (IoT) Internet of Things and cloud computing into the current waste management system.

articleTitle: Real Time Agricultural Monitoring with Deep Learning Using Wireless Sensor Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Agriculture serves as the backbone of India's economy, playing a pivotal role in shaping the nation's financial well-being. The presence of weeds greatly reduces the nutrient content of the soil. The proposed solution in this paper entails the utilization of a technology-driven approach for crop monitoring and weed management. The device consists of wireless sensor nodes spread throughout the field and a mobile weed detection and weedicide spraying unit. This innovative weed detection and weedicide spraying unit will be installed in an autonomous vehicle. The bot will consist of a camera module that will transfer the image data to a Deep learning model hosted on a local machine using WiFi. Using the results of the Deep learning model targeted weedicide spraying is achieved. The WSN network will be used to collect physical information of the field. This will be useful for smart irrigation. Using this system the random use of weedicides used can be checked. The farmer can remotely monitor the fields and efficiently irrigate them. Thus preventing the soil from degradation.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Superiority: Comparative Analysis of ANFIS, FOPID, and PI Controllers in Grid-Connected EV Systems for G2V/V2G Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: For successful Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) and Grid-to-Vehicle (G2V) operations, it is essential to have a Bi-Directional power exchange between plug-in electric vehicles (PEVs) and the AC electrical grid. This manuscript introduces an Adaptive control-based non-isolated Bi-Directional Buck-Boost converter that effectively manages the charging and discharging of Electric Vehicle (EV) batteries based on reference values. Additionally, the study includes a comparative analysis, evaluating the converter's performance against conventional controllers such as FOPID and PI. Using MATLAB/Simulink, a single-phase On-Board Electric Vehicle Charger is simulated with three different controllers: PI, FOPID, and ANFIS. The comparative analysis clearly demonstrates the superior effectiveness of ANFIS-based controllers over FOPID and PI controllers.

articleTitle: Study of Urban Change Detection Using Landsat 8 Satellite Data: A Case Study of Dehradun City, Uttarakhand, India
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Urbanization is an important factor which causes major effect on the availability of land in any study area. Ecological growth and Economic development of Dehradun region is the two main factors which affected the change in land cover. In this study, we analyzed the changes in urban area of Dehradun region within a span of five years from 2013 to 2018 and measure the area converted from other land cover to urban. Remote sensing and GIS technique has been used to analyze the changes in the urban area of Dehradun district. The updated information about the land cover of any region is necessary to control the problems arising due to the irregular activities of human beings. Therefore, the proper arrangement can be made to reduce the impact of urbanization on the forest, agriculture, bare land and water bodies.

articleTitle: Robust Control Design for Grid-Tied EV System with SOGI-Based Architecture in Wide Voltage Range Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The development of a 1-Φ, 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-stage OBC (On-Board Charger) for low load might operate in (G2V) Grid to Vehicle operating modes is shown in this paper. For this objective, a 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup>-Order Generalized Integrator control technique, that demonstrates a robust steady state and exceptional vibrant behavior, is used to govern the H-bridge inverter. An electric vehicle (EV) charger's 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup>-stage AC/DC converter plays a critical role in preserving the grid's power factor unity. to maintain the power quality PQ of the grid within the limits established by the IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission)-61 000-3-2 while it is in use. Additionally, several operating situations, including swell & sag grid voltage, and other factors have been used to confirm the design's performance. Buck-Bosst converters are employed in the second step of the process to convert DC to DC. To regulate the switches on the DC-DC converter, a proportional integral controller is used. The battery's charging current and voltage are monitored and managed using a PWM controller with a constant battery current. An detailed examination of simulation data is conducted for 1.3kWatts system rating. An extra inductive load is connected to grid in order to test its responsiveness.

articleTitle: Composite Power System Reliability Evaluation Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This paper uses Deep learning and Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) to speed up composite power system reliability evaluation. Due to recurring optimum power flow (OPF) solutions, reliability evaluation approaches for large integrated power grids are computationally demanding. Machine learning can avoid OPF in reliability assessment by identifying system states as successful or failed. They can only assess energy and power indices by solving OPF for all failures. This research calculates minimal load curtailments without OPF, except during training. Power, energy, probability, and frequency indices are evaluated. This paper presents a neural network based classification technique and linear regression based regression for evaluating composite power systems reliability. The proposed framework is illustrated through IEEE RTS 79 and 96 test systems. Findings show that the proposed method calculates composite system reliability indices accurately and efficiently.

articleTitle: Denoising of Fundus Images Using Feed-Forward Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The biomedical image denoising method has developed into one of the most fascinating study fields today. Every day, lots of biomedical images are taken, and it is from these images that diseases have been diagnosed. To diagnose eye-related diseases, a fundus image is taken. Early detection of eye-related illnesses is essential to prevent severe problems like cataracts and blindness in the future. The analytical procedure is hampered by a noisy fundus, which makes diagnosis difficult. As a result, it's necessary to lessen noise without sacrificing image quality (blood vessels, optic disk, macula, hemorrhage, and exudate). Therefore, classical denoising methods, transform denoising technique and Deep Learning based denoising method have been utilized to diminish these noises and results have been compared based on structural similarity Index matrix (SSIM) and peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR). Finally, Feed-forward Denoising Convolutional Neural Networks (DnCNN) technique outperforms over all others conventional as well as Deep Learning (SDCDAE, GAN-CT, RED-CNN, and CNN-DWT) denoising methods. In DnCNN Residual learning and Batch normalization (RL and BN) have been utilized to accelerate task of training in addition boosts the denoising performance on the same time, preservers the important features of images. DnCNN technique has been provided better results on the specified noise levels as well as unknown noise levels.

articleTitle: Self-Interference Cancellation in a Full-Duplex MIMO Relay Under Non-Linear Hardware Impairments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Full-duplex communication is a promising technique that enables concurrent transmission and reception of a signal, consequently improving the spectral efficiency. This is achieved by deploying a multiple antenna unit wherein a subset of antennas is used for transmitting the signal, whereas the remaining antennas are used for receiving the signal. However, this rise to a new challenge called self-interference, which can severely degrade system performance in the presence of non-linear hardware impairments and noise. In this study, we analyze the effects of hardware impairments on the bit error rate (BER) performance of a Full duplex transceiver that is used as a relay. For this, we present a behavioral model-based framework that models the non-linearities in multiple antenna set-up-based full-duplex relay constituting mixers, oscillators, and power amplifiers. We use the proposed model to characterize the impairments and evaluate the BER performance. The results highlight the impact of hardware impairments on the BER and provide a performance comparison with an existing scheme. The findings of this study can guide the design and optimization of full-duplex systems by considering hardware impairments and improving the overall system performance.

articleTitle: Improving Feature Vector for Extractive Text Summarization of Legal Judgement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Extractive Text summarization in legal judgment has the key task of finding important information from the legal text and representing it in concise summaries. Large amounts of legal documents can be effectively produced into summaries through the use of extractive text summarization. Finding the most important and informative details for summarizing might be difficult, though, due to the volume of material in legal papers. The task of feature selection in legal documents for extractive text summarization is covered in this article. The goal of this study is to examine and evaluate the value of feature selection methods for enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of legal text summaries. Features like sentence length, sentence position, Term frequency and inverse sentence frequency (TF-ISF), degree of similarity, keywords, and citation are used. To extract the most important details from legal papers, this paper provides a methodology that incorporates both generic text elements and domain-specific legal features. This feature selection method will enable us to find the most important sentences in the judgment. Using a large Indian-Extractive dataset (IN-Ext) of legal documents, the proposed approach is examined.

articleTitle: Optimizing Electricity Bill, Grid Performance, and User Satisfaction in a Comprehensive Home Energy Management System with Electric Vehicles and Home-to-Grid Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In the era of smart grid advancements, innovative techniques, and control methods empower consumers to embrace flexible electricity transactions. Consequently, the pressing need arises for a home energy management system that fosters efficient energy consumption, user satisfaction, and adherence to grid requirements. This research study introduces a comprehensive home energy management system that seamlessly integrates solar PV and electric vehicles. The primary objective of the system is to minimize electricity bill, system peak-to-average ratio as grid performance index, and user discomfort. Binary particle swarm optimization is employed as an efficient optimization tool to achieve optimal results. The home energy management system incorporates Home-to-Grid capability, enabling surplus PV generation, electric vehicles battery and energy storage system power to be fed back to the grid. The implemented scheme achieves a remarkable 64.77 % cost reduction compared to the base price with HEMS, while also reducing PAR and DI by 22.67% and 21.42% respectively.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Microwave Absorbing Materials Through Radar Cross Section Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The performance evaluation of Microwave Absorbing Materials through Radar Cross Section (RCS) Simulation is presented in this paper. The material measurements method is used to calculate complex permittivity and complex permeability. These parameters are calculated using Scattering Parameters (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> and S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>). The RCS of uncoated artillery shell and Cobalt filled Multi Walled Carbon Nanotubes (Co-MWCNTs) composite coated artillery shell is simulated at 8-12GHz frequency range using CST Microwave Studio. The maximum simulated RCS for uncoated shell is −15.8dBsm while the maximum simulated RCS for Co-MWCNTs coated shell is − 35.6dBsm at 11.5GHz frequency. The maximum simulated RCS reduction of Co-MWCNTs coated shell has been achieved is 19.8dB at 11.5GHz frequency. It is evident from the results that the simulated results of Microwave Absorbing Material coated artillery shell have better RCS than uncoated artillery shell.

articleTitle: The Development of Machine Learning Method for Analyzing EEG Signals for Diagnosisng Alzheimer Diesease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The prevalence of mental disorders is on the rise in the present era, significantly impacting individuals' lives and overall health. It is crucial to have accurate methods for diagnosing such conditions. Unfortunately, there is currently no specific method developed for predicting Alzheimer's disease. The diagnosis is typically based on clinical data and laboratory tests. Although techniques like genetic biomarkers can be useful, they are expensive and time-consuming. As a result, electroencephalography (EEG) emerges as a valuable technique for Alzheimer's disease diagnosis. This study assesses the efficacy of machine learning algorithms, namely Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Decision Tree, in forecasting Alzheimer's disease based on the analysis of PhysioNet datasets. The accuracy achieved using the Decision Tree algorithm is 60%, while the SVM algorithm achieves an accuracy of 90%.

articleTitle: Application of a Modified Non-Bridged Cuk Converter for an Active PF Improved BLDC Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This article illustrates a dual-stage modified non-bridged (NB) Cuk converter used power factor (PF) ameliorated BLDC Motor (BLDCM) drive with lesser components. Supply-side unity PF is a goal that the suggested BLDCM drive has the potential to attain. Mains side inductance, which reduces mains current disturbances and removes the need for additional filters to correct mains current harmonics, is a feature of the improved NB-Cuk converter-powered BLDCM drive. The provided modified non-bridged Cuk converter has less parts, which not only makes the driver smaller but also lowers the cost of making it. A MATLAB Simulink simulation model is created to verify the PF ameliorated Cuk converter-powered BLDCM drive that has been suggested. The article's presented adaptive converter is designed to operate in discontinuous conduction mode (DCM). The results of the simulations shown demonstrate the effectiveness of the suggested converter in reaching the intended result.

articleTitle: Design of Two-Channel Linear Phase Filter Bank Using Sparse PSO
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In this paper, the Sparse PSO algorithm-based approach for designing two-channel filter bank, also termed as quadrature mirror filter (QMF) bank is introduced. The design problem construction for QMF includes the design of a prototype filter. A weighted error minimization-based objective function is utilized to reduce stopband, passband, and transition band errors. The effectiveness of sparse PSO is contrasted with that of hybrids of particle swarm and firefly optimization, particle swarm and artificial bee colony optimization (ABC PSO), and particle swarm and gravitational search optimization (PSO GSA) for the QMF bank design issue. Sparse PSO provided lower values of best, mean, worst, and standard deviation of cost and faster convergence. The presented methodology shows significant improvement over existing techniques in the literature.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of Breast Cancer Detection Using Microwave Imaging with the Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Microwave imaging is widely spreading in the field of biomedical diagnostics due to its efficient feature of contrast detection. Over a decade, it is prominent in the field of breast cancer detection. Microwave imaging comes up as the non-invasive and non-ionizing approach with least discomfort to the patient in comparison to other conventional approaches. The tumors typically exhibit a higher dielectric value compared to the surrounding breast tissues. Consequently, microwave imaging can facilitate the detection and localization of malignant tumors. The dielectric properties of breast tissue exhibit dispersive characteristics, making it important to estimate these properties for evaluating the efficacy of microwave imaging systems. Additionally, the absence of distinct separation between individual layers of breast tissue necessitates the determination of the effective dielectric constant. Thus, a dielectric mixing model is proposed to estimate the dielectric constant of the breast tissues efficiently. This study mainly focuses on the determination of the feasibility of microwave imaging in the 1–10 GHz frequency range. The critical analysis of the electrical properties of the breast tissues with and without tumor is done in this proposed work. Furthermore, synthetic data generation is done and analyzed using the Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm for the classification of the tumor.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Approach to Predict Spot Market Price in Indian Electricity
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The restructuring of vertically integrated utilities has made the energy market more competitive. The power trading in a deregulated power system is reliant on an auction-based contract between market participants including generators, retailers, and wholesale traders. The electricity market is subject to several constraints imposed by the inherent nature of energy, which necessitates perpetual parity between consumption and production on a continental scale. To address this issue, markets employ pricing algorithms. This paper aims to develop a forecasting model for short-term electricity prices employing a data-driven approach. The model develops a predictive mechanism based on statistical and neural network frameworks. A multi-layer neural network architecture incorporating the backpropagation algorithm is employed. The prediction model is developed using the historical energy price data of a 15-minute day ahead Indian electricity market, available in the IEX webpage. The network is trained using the data from the 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> of March 2023 to the 30<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> of April 2023. The accuracy of the model is analyzed through testing with the data from 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> of May 2023 to 31 st of May 2023. Finally, the exactness of the model is verified using mean absolute percentage error and R2 score. This model provides statistically significant performance for electricity price forecasting.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of RSMA-Based Multi-User MISO System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In this study, we investigate how well a multi-user MISO system performs utilizing the RSMA technique in terms of throughput, energy efficiency, and outage probability. We also investigate how changing the number of antennas affects all three parameters in a Rayleigh fading channel. We derive the relationship between outage probability and transmit power as an analytical expression for analysis. We then perform the Monte Carlo simulation to verify our derived analytical expression of outage probability. The system's throughput is computed analytically and observed as the function of transmit power for a varying number of antennas. We compute the energy efficiency of the system by varying power consumption for a different number of transmit antennas iteratively. Further, based on the above observations we conclude the consequence of the number of antennas on the performance metrics. We extend our study to comment on the usefulness of the choice of the range of power allocation coefficient of the common stream by observing the corresponding plot.

articleTitle: Design of Metasurface Absorber and Polarizer With Pixelated Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In this paper, a pixel-based meta-atom approach is used to demonstrate the absorption and linear polarisation conversion of a terahertz wave by a metasurface. The number of pixels (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N_{p}$</tex>) in the meta-atom is an integral part of how the metasurface behaves like an absorber and polarizer. By changing the number of pixels both absorption and liner-polarization conversion of a pixelated-based metasurface can be controlled. Pixels positioned diagonally exhibit linear polarisation conversion whereas absorptance is observed if the number of pixels is large. With a decrease in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$N_{P}$</tex>, the bandwidth of polarisation conversion changes from broader to narrower. The physics of absorption and polarisation conversion have been investigated using electromagnetic resonances. The pixelated meta-atom approach can be used for a wide range of terahertz applications.

articleTitle: CanScan: Non-Invasive Techniques for Oral Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Oral cancer is a type of cancer that affects the mouth and surrounding areas. Early detection of oral cancer is crucial for successful treatment and can greatly improve patient outcomes. In recent years, advances in image processing, computer vision, and deep learning have enabled the development of effective methods for detecting oral cancer using images. These methods typically involve the use of sophisticated algorithms to analyze images of the mouth and surrounding areas in order to identify abnormalities that may indicate the presence of cancer. By leveraging the power of these techniques, it is possible to improve the accuracy and speed of oral cancer detection, leading to better patient care. Furthermore, these methods have the potential to be cost-effective and widely accessible, making them a promising tool for improving oral cancer detection and treatment.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Evaluation of a Multiband Microstrip Patch Antenna Array for Wireless Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In this study, a microstrip patch antenna for 5G communications is presented. Due to high demand for satellite communication, there is a requirement for expanding S - band, C-band & X-band of the satellite frequency in the communication industry. The proposed design consists of circular and square patch antenna with rectangular and circular slotting in ground plane. It operates for S-band and C-band at frequencies range of 2GHz to 12GHz. The Proposed antenna is designed on FR-4 (lossy) substrate with a loss tangent of 0.002 and a standard thickness of 1.6 mm. The Simulated Antenna gain achieved are 2.39dBi, 3.56dBi, 1.51dBi, 3.54dBi, 1.42dBi, 1.17dBi) with Return loss-27.92dB, −29.80dB, − 12.48dB, −18.83dB, −18.26dB, −20.87dB) operating at 2.1GHz, 2.5GHz, 2.8GHz, 3.3GHz, 3.7GHz, 4.6GHz respectively. The overall patch dimension is optimized to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$28\text{mm}^{\ast}37\text{mm}$</tex>. For excitation, the technique of Microstrip feeding is employed. The Defected Ground Structure technique is used for enhancing the gain of the proposed antenna. The defect disturbs the shielded current distribution which result in a controlled excitation and propagation of electromagnetic waves through substrate layer. This antenna design is simulated using CST Microwave Studio Software.

articleTitle: Identification of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using Facial Images with Big Transfer Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurological disease that is seen in children at an early age. A child with ASD faces challenges while communicating in social meetings. The use of facial expressions is increasing rapidly for the identification of various medical disorders. The work puts forward an approach for the identification of autistic children using facial images with the help of the Big Transfer (BiT) model. The Kaggle dataset comprising 2940 facial images of autistic and typically developing children has been utilized for experiment. The BiT model incorporates the architecture of ResNet50. The BiT model has performed better in comparison to state-of-the-art works by achieving an accuracy of 91.09% and an AUC score of 98%.

articleTitle: Critical Analysis of Machine Learning Technique for Discriminating the Similar Vegetation Pattern
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Although the existing literature has classified the landcover by different techniques for change detection, the classified images obtained by different methods still deserve further discussion. For this reason, by analyzing Machine Learning technique, this study offers a comparison between the Tall vegetation (TV) change in Roorkee region of India due to Highway construction during the period of 2017–2018. In literature researchers attempted the optical and synthetic aperture radar (SAR) image classification with varying degrees of success. The challenge in this type of classifications is to identify urban and dense vegetation (tall vegetation) classes separately. Both these classes have very small amount of variations in the scatter power. A Random forest (RF) algorithm is trained on the combination for efficient classification for urban, dense vegetation and other classes. Random forest classification algorithm is belonging to the ensemble learning category, is the one of the best machine learning algorithms. It combines the predictions generated from multiple decision trees to make accurate predictions or classify data points. In this study the number of tall vegetation pixels decreased from 1977 to 31 due to construction of Highway and tall vegetation removal at other study regions taken at different stretches of Highway, results in significant decrease of tall vegetation area.

articleTitle: Improving Quality Assurance: Automated Defect Detection in Soap Bar Packaging Using YOLO-V5
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In this study, a deep learning algorithm based on the You Only Look Once (YOLO-V5) approach is proposed for the visual inspection of soap bar packaging defects. The defects considered in this study include pack missing, pack opening, and label errors. Images capturing various packaging defects were collected using a hardware setup consisting of a USB camera and a laptop. The collected image dataset was processed using the annotation tool Labellmg. Subsequently, the defect detection model was trained using YOLO-V5 and tested on different images as well as on live camera feeds. An Arduino Mega connected to the laptop via serial communication (USB cable) was utilized to trigger an LED indicating the detection of a defect. The proposed research achieved an accuracy of 98% with an average processing speed of the trained model is 200ms per input image or frame.

articleTitle: True RMS-Weighted KNN Based Underlying Cause Recognition of Power Quality Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Traditional approaches for recognizing the fundamental causes of power quality (PQ) disturbances typically involve time-consuming manual analysis of PQ data by experts. However, with the increasing complexity of power systems, there is a growing need for more automated approaches to PQ diagnosis. To this end, this paper proposes a true RMS and weighted K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) based approach for recognizing three underlying causes of PQ disturbances i.e., capacitor energizing, three-phase fault, and induction motor starting. This true RMS value is calculated for each voltage sample in the power quality data. Using true-RMS voltage amplitude vs time curves, feature extraction has been taken place for several cases of single-stage and multiple disturbances. This feature set has further been provided to a weighted KNN based classifier. The weights are calculated using a Gaussian function, which gives higher weights to neighbors that are closer to the test point. The proposed classifier's accuracy has been compared with the other classifiers using classification leaner app in MATLAB. As a result of which, the highest training accuracy of 99% and testing accuracy of 90.47% has been obtained with weighted KNN algorithm. Thus, the weighted KNN results recommends that the proposed approach performs adequately for classifying single and multiple PQ disturbances and their causes.

articleTitle: Use of Machine Learning on Satellite and Drone Images for Agriculture Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The proposed study's primary goal is to evaluate land use change and land cover (LULC) utilizing machine learning techniques and algorithms. This was done using Sentinel-2 satellite images, which is viewable and available through the Copernicus Earth observation system. These Sentinel-2 photos cover four spectral bands and fall into four categories (urban, water, tall vegetation, short vegetation, and barren ground), and they are identified as Google Earth image data. Different land use classifications represent how much simpler the proposed method makes the process of image classification. The findings and discussion show that Random Forest, ANN, SVM, and KNN were the most effective algorithms for attaining our main goal. For each dataset, cross validation and random sampling were used to determine the best models for achieving the best results with less over fitting and finally different band combinations were used for classification of SAR image.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a Smart and Multipurpose IoT Embedded System Device Using ESP32 Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative design and development of a smart device with IoT capabilities based on the ESP32 microcontroller. This is a compact embedded kit that measures atmospheric pressure, temperature, and humidity, and transmits the data to the IoT website. It features a heart rate sensor that sends data to a custom-designed Android app via Bluetooth and a compass that can sense the direction, displaying the current date and time. The compact embedded kit smart device has several potential applications, such as checking share market graphs and live sports scores through the internet. It can also be reprogrammed as a health monitoring system, drone controller, car controller, or different system controller like home automation, depending on the user's needs. Furthermore, students can connect various sensors to the device to learn embedded systems, as several embedded programs are available.

articleTitle: A PFI Bridgeless Cuk Converter-Based LED Lamp Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Present paper deals with modelling, designing, and simulation of a power factor improved (PFI) LED (Light Emitting Diode) drive system. To maintain power quality as per IEC-61000-3-2 standards (which govern the limits on permissible harmonic contents) presented LED drive system uses a bridgeless Cuk converter for PFI operation. The bridgeless Cuk converter uses a common output inductor during both supply voltage cycles which eliminates the requirement of one extra inductor with respect to conventional Cuk converter bridgeless operation. The bridgeless PFI Cuk converter feeds the flyback converter which feeds the LED lamp load. To reduce the requirement of extra sensors the LED drive system is operated in discontinuous inductor current mode (DiCM). Simulation results are presented in this paper for the validation of the drive system for a LED lamp load of 18 W.

articleTitle: A Compact CSRR Loaded 4-Port MIMO Antenna for V2X Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This work presents a 4-port compact (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda\times\lambda\times .029\lambda$</tex>) MIMO antenna Operating within the DSRC (Dedicated Short-Range Communication) band, which spans from 5.850 GHz to 5.925 GHz for vehicle-to-vehicle/Everything (V2V/V2X) communication. To make the size compact, we employ a Complementary split ring resonator (CSRR) beneath each patch. This enhances the isolation between the antenna elements up to 24.31 dB along with a 7 dB gain. The proposed antenna also exhibits good ECC and diversity performance which has been verified by simulation. The designed and fabricated MIMO antenna is suitable for Vehicle to vehicle communication applications due to its compact size and good isolation.

articleTitle: Load Balancing in Cloud Using Honeybee Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In cloud computing, load balancing distributes traffic and workloads to make sure that no one server or computer is idle, overburdened, or underloaded. In order to increase total cloud performance, load balancing optimizes a number of limited factors, including execution time, response time, and system stability. There are numerous alternative load balancing algorithms that each have their own benefits and drawbacks. Users may experience performance issues when a server is overcrowded. This can be avoided by load balancing, which distributes the workload among several servers. There are several different load balancing methods that can be applied. One such method is to employ a round-robin DNS. Each request is delivered to a different server in a round-robin method with round-robin DNS. This guarantees that the amount of traffic reaching each server is equal. Honeybee optimization (HBO) is one of the most promising new load balancing methods. A bio-inspired algorithm called HBO is based on how honeybees behave. The capacity of honeybees to determine the quickest route between their colony and a food source is well recognized. To discover the best load balancing option, HBO employs a similar capability. A metaheuristic algorithm called Honeybee Optimization (HBO) is based on the feeding habits of honey bees. Honey bees use a well developed algorithm to locate food sources. This paper introduces the improved method for honey bee optimization.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Systolic Array for 2D Convolution Using Residue Number System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This paper presents an FPGA implementation of a systolic architecture for 2D convolution using the residue number system (RNS) with a designed new residue adder and residue multiplier. The proposed architecture offers improved processing speed by leveraging the benefits of RNS. Additionally, the use of a systolic array enhances parallelism, further boosting the overall performance of the convolution operation. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach, highlighting its potential for accelerated convolutional neural networks and real-time signal processing applications.

articleTitle: Predicting Rain and Thunderstorm in Jaipur Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The accurate prediction of thunderstorms is of utmost importance due to their potential to cause severe and hazardous weather conditions. This study focuses on the prediction of rain and thunderstorm occurrences in Jaipur, Rajasthan, using machine learning techniques. Through comprehensive evaluation, the Random Forest Classifier consistently demonstrates superior performance compared to other models for predicting “Rain,” “Thunderstorm,” and “Thunderstorm with Rain” events, achieving accuracy levels between 92.55% to 98.92%. The exceptional accuracy and robustness of the Random Forest model make it a highly effective tool for weather forecasting and climatic analysis in Jaipur, holding significant value across various sectors that rely on precise weather information.

articleTitle: PixelVerse: Secure and Efficient File Storage and Transfer through Video Embedding
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: PixelVerse is a novel approach for secure file transfer, which uses video embedding to ensure data integrity and avoid compression. This paper presents an in-depth evaluation of the PixelVerse methodology, consisting of video encoding, compression prevention, data extraction, and importing. We display the effectiveness of PixelVerse using three unique modes: best compression resistance, Enhanced compression resistance, and maximum performance. Furthermore, we explore the applications and target markets of PixelVerse and provide real-life use cases. The research findings and assessments indicate that PixelVerse proves to be a proficient and dependable solution for secure file-sharing and storage, as evidenced by performance measures and the results. PixelVerse finds practical applications in various industries such as healthcare, finance, and legal services, where safeguarding data confidentiality and privacy through secure file storage and transfer are of utmost importance.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Multi-Level Converters in Real-Time Using OPAL-RT Simulators
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to address the unpredictable energy demand and the increasing use of domestic solar PV applications. The proposed solution is a multi-level-boost converter design that utilizes basic pulse width modulation (PWM) technology and offers a simple operational method. The converter combines DC to DC switched capacitors and multi-level-boost converters, incorporating a double-driven switch, two inductors, (2N-1) diodes, and (2N) capacitors and filter capacitor also to ensure a balanced output voltage. To enhance the performance of solar power PV applications, the paper introduces the concept of parallel double inductors (PDL) and series double switches (SDS) with Dual capacitors (DC) for multi-level-boost converters. The PDL-based multi-level-boost converter demonstrates superior performance in a real-time simulator (OPAL-RT). The paper thoroughly analyzes open loop topology based on multi-level-boost converters, examining their use of low voltage levels to achieve high-voltage outputs, and provides comprehensive results to discuss voltage stress and voltage gain with the proposed multi-level-boost converter.

articleTitle: Design and Control of a Robotic Hand for Generating Gestures Based on Indian Sign Language
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The gestures involving hand movements are an important aspect of communication, particularly for speech and hearing-impaired persons. There are many travellers worldwide that use gestures involving hand movements as a source of communication when traveling in countries where they need to communicate with persons having speech and hearing disability. Sign language is a type of language that is used by persons who are unable to hear or speak. The paper mainly focuses on gesture generation based on Indian Sign Language which is used in the deaf community all over India. To assist persons having speech and hearing disabilities there is a requirement for the design of a Robotic hand model that could generate various gestures corresponding to the speech delivered in the form of alphabets by the different persons based on the Indian Sign Language system. Considering the experimental results achieved the proposed model of the design of the robotic hand interpreter system generates the gesture corresponding to the different alphabets used in the Indian Sign Language system accurately. The overall accuracy of the robotic hand interpreter system model based on the experimental results is 94 percent based on the signs generated by it.

articleTitle: Detection of Malus Plant Infection Using Fifteen Layer Deep Convolutional Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Apple (scientifically malus domestica) is the fruit which is having high quality of nutrients. For a human being, Fruit consumption is the necessity for getting the nutrients. If it is found out that fruit is affected by some infectious agents, it can harm the health as well as wealth of the human. In terms of apple, farmers whose earnings are dependent on the production, will get economical loss, further financially state and country loss. Here, the proposed model is used to detect the symptoms of disease present in apple orchard with the help of apple leaves using fifteen layer deep convolutional neural network model. In a form of data set that is used here are of four categories such as apple scab, apple powdery mildew, apple rust, and apple healthy. The outcome of the model is giving accuracy and validation accuracy 97.91 and 97.8% respectively.

articleTitle: Hybrid Protocol for Cluster Head Selection for Energy Efficient Routing in WSN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The paper introduces Hybrid protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) which is modification of LEACH protocol using Machine learning. The protocol considers traffic awareness, energy levels, and distance metrics to optimize the performance of the network. This protocol uses the K-medoid algorithm for initial clustering. The K-medoid algorithm is known for its ability to form clusters effectively based on data points distances. This approach uses various factors such as distance, traffic load, and energy levels to make intelligent decisions in choosing the most suitable candidate nodes as cluster heads. In re-cluster head selection, Support vector machine (SVM) is used. The performance is compared with the Low Energy Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) protocol, which is a widely used clustering protocol in WSNs. The results of the performance evaluation demonstrate that ML-EERP achieves significant improvements in energy efficiency compared to the traditional LEACH protocol. This highlights the effectiveness of utilizing machine learning techniques in the selection of cluster heads, leading to enhanced energy efficiency and improved network performance. By adopting a machine learning-based approach, the proposed ML-EERP protocol offers a promising solution for addressing energy efficiency concerns in WSN.

articleTitle: Underwater Diver Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In recent years, usage and applications of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles has grown rapidly. Interaction of divers with the AUVs remains an integral part of the usage of AUVs for various applications and makes building robust and efficient underwater gesture recognition systems extremely important. In this paper we propose an Underwater Gesture Recognition system trained on the Cognitive Autonomous Diving Buddy Underwater gesture dataset using deep learning that achieves 98.01% accuracy on the dataset, which to the best of our knowledge is the best performance achieved on this dataset at the time of writing this paper. We also improve the Gesture Recognition's System Interpretability by using XAI techniques to visualize model's predictions.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction of Induction Motor Usingmachine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In recent industries, fault detection prior to their occurrence or complete shutdown the induction motor is essential. The recent application of machine learning and condition monitoring methods to fault detection has enormous potential. For motor fault detection, machine learning's power can be harnessed and utilized to its full potential. In order to avoid losses, the issue, particularly in the induction motor, needs to be addressed promptly. A dependable and efficient approach to preventive maintenance can be found in the utilization of AI calculation applications in the idea of shortcoming location. In arrange to portray the functioning status of acceptance engines with regards to current, voltage, and temperature, as well as alert through a buzzer and be updated in an IoT-based application or email, a new learning technique based on algorithms is developed in this paper. To achieve automated and intelligent fault diagnosis, it together and perform the feature extraction steps with the several task.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Image Synthesis Based Channel Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for estimating the time-frequency response of a rapidly fading communication channel in an OFDM system. The technique employs deep learning methods for the estimation of unknown channel response matrix values, given known pilot site values. The proposed method utilizes a universal pipeline based on deep image processing methods, such as image super-resolution and image restoration. The pilot values are treated as a low-resolution image, and the channel is estimated using a super-resolution (SR) network and a denoising iterative residual reconstruction (IRR) network. The paper also includes a practical example of the proposed pipeline and demonstrates that it outperforms the previously used channel net approach. Furthermore, the proposed method achieves performance comparable to the minimum mean square error (MMSE) approach when all channel characteristics are known.

articleTitle: MarbleBot: A Conversational Recommender and Assistance Chatbot for Marble Selection Based on Dialogflow
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The marble industry offers a vast selection of styles, presenting a challenge for customers seeking the ideal marble for their homes or businesses. To address this, chatbots have emerged as a convenient means for customers to receive instant assistance and personalized recommendations. This paper introduces a marble recommender and assistance chatbot designed for a Marble and Granite selling company. The recommendation process integrates both content-based filtering and natural language processing (NLP) techniques. Utilizing Dialogflow, we developed and implemented the chatbot on the company's website. Through dialogue-based interactions, a conversational recommender system was established. The system adeptly comprehends various natural language queries and delivers relevant recommendations based on individual customer preferences. To evaluate the system's performance, we measured the accuracy of recommendations and user satisfaction. Our user study findings reveal that the chatbot provided users with a satisfying experience and achieved an impressive accuracy rate of 85%. The chatbot, named MarbleBot, proves to be an indispensable tool in helping users discover the perfect marble that suits their needs. The paper proceeds in a chronological order, beginning with the introduction, followed by a comprehensive review of relevant literature. The research methodology section outlines the tools employed, including Dialogflow methodology, Flask-API, MySQL database, system design, and pre-processing steps. Subsequently, we present the results, encompassing evaluation tools and an analysis of testing outcomes. Finally, the paper concludes with a summary of our findings and potential future directions.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of a Dual-Band BPF for 5G mmWave Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This brief presents a design method for a millimeter-wave dual band bandpass filter (DB-BPF) that can be integrated on a chip. To create a dual-band bandpass filter, a modification of an existing resonator that was originally designed for a single band pass filter (BPF) has been proposed. This modification allowed the resonator to pass signals in two different frequency bands. To better comprehend the approach, simplified LC-equivalent circuit models were created. These models helped in understanding how the proposed design would perform. Upon conducting a comprehensive simulation of the proposed design, the outcomes demonstrated its excellent functionality within the millimeter-wave frequency range. The filter design exhibits centre frequencies at 20GHz and 40 GHz, possessing 3-dB fractional bandwidths of 18% and 4% respectively. Impressive return loss values of 43 dB and 40 dB were obtained precisely at the centre frequencies. Furthermore, the filter exhibits three transmission zeros precisely located at 15.13 GHz, 26.06 GHz, and 46.66 GHz. Moreover, the filter design has a notable stopband attenuation of 20-dB, effectively suppressing the frequency ranges from dc to 17 GHz, 24 GHz to 30 GHz, and also from 44 GHz to 56 GHz is also achieved.

articleTitle: Ensembled HAR Approach Using Stacking on Inertial Sensors Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In the last few years, vast growth has been monitored in the Human Activity Recognition (HAR) domain which includes applications such as surveillance, healthcare monitoring, and smart home. The reason for this widespread growth is the scope of pocket-friendly and multi-modal data collection through already present devices such as smartphones, security cameras in home and public places, and Wi-fi devices at home as well as offices. The inclusion of deep learning (DL) techniques has made the task of activity identification simple and reduced the challenges like manual feature extraction, huge dataset handling, etc. In the proposed study we have proposed three DL models with convolutional neural networks and long short-term recurrent networks. We have further proposed an enhanced performance HAR model Ens-HAR with a stacked ensemble approach. To evaluate the proposed model's performance, we have used the UCI-HAR model which is publicly available for research. We have achieved an accuracy of 92.26%, 93.35%, 90.26%, and 94.79% on CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, and Ens-HAR models respectively.

articleTitle: An Efficient Broadband Absorber Design and Development Using E-Waste Based Heterogeneous Composite
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Heterogenous composites show a viable role in designing wideband microwave absorbers to fulfill the current demand in shielding applications. However, to develop cost-effective absorber having wide bandwidth with less thickness (< 3.5 mm) using waste material is very difficult task. In this paper, CI/EW based heterogenous composites were successfully developed using electronic-waste with the variation in wt.% of carbonyl iron from 10 to 50. To develop these composites two conventional preparation methods i.e., ball mill and blending method were used. The results show that C, X, and Ku-bands are covered by the developed single layer absorber with wide bandwidth of 7.5 GHz at the thickness of only 3 mm. The optimized use of e-waste and carbonyl iron makes the developed absorber cost-effective to be used in shielding applications.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach for Image Forgery Detection Using Deep Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The advent of digital platforms revolutionized sharing of personal images and videos on social media. Intruders extract and modify these images to gain popularity or favor. There is freely available software that changes these images very quickly. If the image is forged, the algorithm should detect it and stop to publish on social media. Copy-move and splicing forgery are prevalent methods of image forgery. To combat these forgeries, a real-time deep learning-based approach has been developed, providing enhanced social security in today's society. This approach can effectively detect and identify counterfeit images shared on various social media platforms. The real-time forgery detection algorithms are developed using supervised learning. This algorithm is tested on publicly available datasets such as DVMM, CMFD, and Colombia.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis for Classifying Mixed Classes Using Sentinel 1 and Sentinel 2 Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In developing countries like India, the cropping pattern is highly heterogeneous, with similar crops grown in adjacent small patches called mixed classes. Classifying these mixed classes using single sensor data is challenging due to their random behavior. To overcome this challenge, a combination of optical and SAR data is used as they provides complementary information. By exploiting the absorption and reflectance characteristics of plant pigments across different optical bands, vegetation indices are derived, that characterize different plant biophysical properties and are more sensitive to canopy parameters than individual bands. Similarly, SAR backscattering coefficients and their derived parameters offer insights into the structural characteristics of the plants. Therefore, this study explored the potential of using multiple vegetation indices from Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data to solve the mixed class classification problem. The Random Forest (RF) classifier, known for modeling complex relationships, is employed. Experimental results showed that combining vegetation indices with Sentinel-1 derived parameters significantly improved the classification accuracy of the mixed classes compared to relying solely on band values. This approach increased the accuracy from 87.2% to 96.5%.

articleTitle: Frequency Calibration System for wBMS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: A wireless battery monitoring system (wBMS) eliminates the need for physical wiring by wirelessly transmitting battery module data to a central system. It optimizes battery performance, prevents overcharging, and enables real-time monitoring. However, challenges such as interference and temperature variations can affect the system. To overcome these challenges, synchronization is crucial for accurate communication, while monitoring environmental temperature ensures reliable data analysis. Combining frequency calibration, synchronization, and temperature monitoring is essential for a reliable wBMS. This project aimed to design and analyze a tailored frequency calibration module for wBMS, involving hardware and software integration. The implemented frequency calibration system achieved a calibration accuracy of 99.95% for centre frequencies of different channels with an execution time of 9.25ms. It effectively mitigates the effects of environmental changes, making it a valuable solution for maintaining stable wireless systems.

articleTitle: Emergency Response App for Enhancing Location-Based Services Using Socket.io and WebRTC
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: India ranks among the top countries experiencing worst traffic congestion in the world. According to the reports, in India it takes more than 400 minutes to reach a hospital for every second heart attack patient which is almost 13 times more than the ideal time of 30 minutes. The primary aim of this proposed solution is to minimize the response time of ambulances approaching the needy. Our proposed approach of the ‘One-Tap-Button’ emergency response app provides just one ‘SOS’ (Save Our Souls) button which sends the location of the user to the nearest hospital or medical center within a definite range set in the app via a library called socket.io. The location with the notification mentioning the details of the patient/victim is viewed in the integrated Google Maps app interface. A GPS (Global Positioning System) modem fitted in the ambulance which is responsible for keeping live track of their location by the servers i.e., the hospital's portal. WebRTC (Web Real-Time Communications) live video streaming feature enables direct patient-doctor communication during emergencies, facilitating real-time audio and video transmission. This seamless integration enhances emergency response and prompt healthcare communication.

articleTitle: Internet-of-Things Enabled Automation of E-Logistic Framework for Healthcare Sector in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Strong operations and advancement of a viable and feasible city coordinations framework are vital for building economical cities. Be that as it may, city coordinations confront viable tangles due to the incongruent benefits among various performing artists, and the vague portion or constrained support of the civic division. The concept of a supply chain includes innovations and ideas pointed at making cities additional viable, in fact progressed, ecologically friendly, and casually comprehensive, counting specialized, financial, and communal developments. The IoT empowers organizations to mechanize forms and make strides benefit conveyance through Web innovation and cloud-based information exchange. In this paper, we have effectively accomplished automation of e-logistics applications within the healthcare segment, coming about in fetched proficiency and higher accuracy rates. The objective of the paper is to make a show or gadget for following and overseeing the computerization of e-logistics within the healthcare segment, with diminished operational costs and greatest proficiency. This study improves our understanding of the require for mechanization of IoT-based e-logistics system for viable and proficient improvement of smart cities in healthcare segment and will serve as a premise for pending works/ investigate.

articleTitle: Improved K-Means Clustering Algorithm for Band Selection in Hyperspectral Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Band selection plays a major role in hyperspectral pixel classification. Clustering-based approaches gained more attention in recent years for optimal band selection. Despite some limitations in identifying non-convex-shaped clusters, the k-means clustering-based band selection is widely used because of its simplicity to implement. The quality of clustering and the efficiency of band selection depends on the similarity measure. This article presents an improved k-means clustering algorithm for band selection using the spectral similarity measures like Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM), Spectral Information Divergence (SID), and the hybrid similarity measure of SID and SAM (SID-SAM), Normalised Cross-correlation (NCC), Jeffery-Matusita (JM), Jeffery-Matusita With Spectral Angle Mapper (JM-SAM). Further, the efficiency of these spectral similarity measures for clustering based band selection are analyzed on various benchmark datasets utilizing the state-of-the-art machine learning classifiers like K-Nearest Neighbours(KNN), Decision Tree(DT) and Support Vector Machines(SVM) for pixel classification of HSI.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for IoT Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Our daily lives are a big part of how the Internet of Things (IoT) has had a great impact in numerous industries thanks to technological advancements for resource optimization. IoT devices primarily rely on gathering data from the physical environment and sending it via a network of heterogeneous devices to perform services.
