This paper introduces two novel approaches for community clustering of generic graph networks using the VAT family of algorithms, even without prior knowledge about the community structure. Two proposed approaches: Spec-GVAT and Jacc-GVAT, reconstructs the community structure in graphs effectively with a satisfactory run time and high level of accuracy. Spec-GVAT is spectral graph theory based, while Jacc-GVAT incorporates a pairwise dissimilarity score based on Jaccard similarity between two sets. Numerical experiments performed on five benchmark datasets: Zachary karate club network, Girvan-Newman graph, planted l-partition graph, American college football network, and Bottlenose dolphins network, validate the supremacy of proposed approaches compared to conventional methods.

articleTitle: Seamless Live Ambulance Booking System with Patient Health Monitoring: Enhancing Emergency Care
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The rapid advancement of technology has paved the way for significant improvements in emergency medical services (EMS). In this paper, we present a unique and innovative approach to emergency medical services (EMS) through the integration of a live ambulance booking system with patient health monitoring. Our system combines real-time ambulance booking functionality with comprehensive patient health monitoring capabilities, revolutionizing emergency care and improving patient outcomes. Through an intuitive interface accessible via mobile applications and web portals, users can effortlessly request emergency ambulance services, enabling timely assistance. Leveraging advanced geolocation technologies, the system dispatches the nearest available ambulance equipped with the necessary medical resources. Additionally, our system incorporates real-time patient health monitoring, capturing vital signs through wearable sensors or IoT-enabled devices. This data is transmitted to the emergency response center, empowering healthcare professionals to remotely monitor patients during transit and make informed decisions. Robust privacy measures, including data encryption and access controls, ensure patient confidentiality. By seamlessly integrating ambulance booking with health monitoring, our system enhances the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of emergency care, ultimately saving lives.

articleTitle: Multi-Module Deep Learning and IoT-Based Pest Detection System Using Sound Analytics in Large Agricultural Field
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Agriculture has progressed to an advanced stage worldwide and into an economical source of sophisticated agricultural practices. It is a significant milestone in the history of agriculture. The broad embrace of information and today's advanced technology has paved the way for this evolution. But pests cause substantial harm to farming, which has serious financial, ecological, and societal repercussions. That emphasizes the significance of computerized systems for early pest detection. Agricultural issues have recently emerged as a significant focus for machine learning-based research. This study offers an efficient Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled pest detection system that uses pest sound analytics in large agricultural fields. The system is built on a model called a Graph-based Pyramid Attention-multi module deep convolutional neural network (GPA-Net). The GPA-Net platform comprises a variety of essential subcomponents, a couple of which are the CSPNet, CTA, and SPA. The GPA-Net model has been trained using the sounds of the pests. The outcomes of the demonstrations revealed that the recommended GPA-Net model successfully identified the pest and outscored the state-of-the-art models YOLOv5, Faster RCNN, and ResNet-50 with 99.75% accuracy and an F1 score of 98.99%.

articleTitle: Sales Prediction in the Retail Industry Using Machine Learning: A Case Study of BigMart
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This research paper presents a machine learning-based approach for sales prediction in the retail industry. The study was conducted using data collected from the BigMart retail chain. The research aimed to develop an accurate predictive model to forecast different products' sales in various BigMart stores. The study involved the implementation of several machine learning algorithms, including linear regression, decision tree, random forest, gradient boosting, support vector machine, convolutional neural network, and long short-term memory. The models were trained and evaluated using a dataset comprising of over 8,000 entries of sales data from different BigMart stores. The results showed that the convolutional neural network and long short-term memory models outperformed the other algorithms in terms of accuracy, with an R-squared value of 0.68 and 0.69, respectively. The study also identified the most significant features affecting sales, including item weight, store location, and promotional activities. The findings of this research have significant implications for the retail industry, as accurate sales prediction can help businesses optimize their inventory management and marketing strategies. The study also highlights the potential of machine learning algorithms for sales forecasting in the retail sector. In conclusion, this research demonstrates the effectiveness of machine learning in predicting sales and highlights the importance of leveraging advanced analytical techniques for improving business performance in the retail industry.

articleTitle: A Survey on Intrusion Detection System for IoT Networks Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Internet of Things(IoT) devices is the prime factor in automating the real world in the past few years. These networks provide efficient utilization of resources, quality data, and benefits with reduced human input as well as have secured processing which results in a high potential for automating the healthcare and defence systems. Noticing the large number of attacks on these networks in previous years, there is a vast study to detect the intrusion by attackers to ease the use of these devices without the fear of losing data. This survey is a deep study of works on detecting the intrusion in IoT networks and devices revolving around the use of Machine Learning and Deep Learning based algorithms on real-world datasets like “Bot-IoT” and “KDD”. The survey provides a building block in understanding the basics of Intrusion and also the benefits of Intrusion detection systems and thus promotes the researchers to focus more on prevention of such attacks. Furthermore, it compiles the studies from the year 2016 and compares the models of Machine Learning and Deep Learning segregated based on Data sets used in training; also, summarizes the performance of such mechanisms.

articleTitle: Court Judgement Prediction Using Long-Short Term Memory and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Ever thought about law and enforcement, how much will be the data in the sector of law and enforcement. Even for one single judgement, the judge and the lawyer and related personals must refer several references like previous cases, judgments, victims, situations, duration, time, evidence, count of evidence, judges, advocates, they must study each, and the whole thing ultimately related to their current case. Along with time the historical data in the legal sector also increased a lot, nowadays the industrialists are trying to collect such legal information and data to estimate the judgements by analysing and compiling the collected data with the help of court case rules. Even though they tried a lot to find the judgements, it becomes failure without a proper implementation. But if the machine learning algorithms are implemented for the judgement prediction, it can be observed victorious and accurate prediction as compared to the normal conventional method of forecasting the judgements. The major intention of the investigation is to predict the court judgements with the help of hybrid neural network model (long short-term memory and convolutional neural network). Through optimization of features, the most applicable datums through means of long short-term memory along with the perception of convolutional neural network model is carried out to expect the court judgements.

articleTitle: Multiple Disease Prediction System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Machine learning (ML) refers to the science and engineering of artificially intelligent systems, providing them with the capability to learn without being explicitly programmed. In recent years, ML in the healthcare domain has made great advancements in the early predictions of many critical illnesses. While there have been significant contributions to single disease prediction systems (like one for heart disease prediction, one for diabetes, and so on), there lacks the existence of an integrated regulatory framework that performs the prediction of multiple diseases under a single interface. This paper proposes a novel “Multiple-disease Prediction System” for the early-stage prediction of Heart Diseases, Parkinson's Disease, Breast Cancer, and Diabetes using efficient Machine Learning algorithms. The novelty of this work lies in the implementation of multiple ML classifiers for each prediction system, followed by their performance evaluation and comparison based on their respective test accuracies. From experimental results, it was observed that Logistic Regression (LR) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) outperformed Decision Tree and Random Forest classifiers in all cases. The highest reported accuracy for LR was 77% for the diabetes model, while SVM obtained accuracy values of 80%, 92%, and 97% for heart disease, Parkinson's disease, and breast cancer models, respectively. Additionally, the work employs efficient data preprocessing techniques with feature selection carried out via Principal Component Analysis (PCA), and by implementing correlation matrices among independent variables. This resulted in reducing the number of features while still maintaining the test accuracies of individual models for the correct prediction of multiple diseases—a step not efficiently captured by previous works. Finally, the integrated framework is deployed in the form of a web app (with multiple constraint checks) to enhance the overall user experience.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Elastic Net Regression, Naive Bayes & Lasso Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This study aims to determine which algorithm is better at estimating target variables based on a set of independent variables. This case study compares three different machine learning algorithms: Naive Bayes, Lasso Regression and Elastic Net Regression. The data used in this research is real-world data with many features. The article begins by explaining how each algorithm works and then evaluates it on various parameters such as Accuracy, Recall, and Prediction. The results of the study shows that Naive Bayes outperforms Lasso Regression and Elastic Net in terms of accuracy and precision, while Elastic Net has the highest return. The article concludes that the choice of algorithm depends on the problem at hand and that researchers should consider all parameters before choosing an appropriate algorithm.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: A Study for Securing IoV Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: New and advanced technologies have introduced amazing areas like the Internet of Vehicles (IoV) and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) etc. With these new emerging technologies and the open nature of these technologies security and privacy are always a serious concern. The enhancement of IoV brought unmanned cars where data security, privacy, physical attack, and getting stolen are always prime concerns. As reported in the literature, we had lost billions of dollars because of stolen cars and cyber-attacks. To avoid these attacks, we have suggested the Blockchain concept to secure IoV. In this era of data and trust where the internet is flooded with information and where we don't even know how our information can be used, data security and confidentiality should be a must. To solve this problem Blockchain comes into the picture with the concept of a decentralized, distributed ledger that stores the records of ownership of digital assets. Any data stored on the blockchain cannot be modified. It is client-client-based technology where data is decentralized in a way that changes in one node will need the permissions of another node. It uses a hash algorithm where the next node has a record of the previous node's state in the hash function. Using this decentralized, distributed ledger or client-client model of blockchain, we will secure our IoV, where we will see how we can secure our confidential data from any cyberattack and physical attack which will try to breach our security levels. We will use different levels of security modes if there are any security breaches or accidents, vehicles will soon send alert warning messages with the location and current state of vehicles to each of its stakeholders and police station.

articleTitle: A Survey of the State-of-the-Art Reinforcement Learning-Based Techniques for Autonomous Vehicle Trajectory Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) have emerged as a promising solution by replacing human drivers with advanced computer-aided decision-making systems. However, for AVs to effectively navigate the road, they must possess the capability to predict the future trajectories of nearby traffic participants, similar to the predictive driving abilities of human drivers. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach for learning complex decision-making policies in dynamic environments. This survey explores the application of RL approaches in trajectory prediction, focusing on inverse reinforcement learning, deep reinforcement learning, and imitation learning. It provides an in-depth analysis of the underlying principles, algorithms, and architectures employed in these methods, highlighting their respective strengths and limitations. Moreover, the survey addresses the current challenges in the field and presents potential future research directions, offering valuable insights to readers.

articleTitle: Comparative Study for Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient and Soft Actor Critic Using an Inverted Pendulum System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Designing optimum controllers using classical approaches is difficult due to the rising need for complicated nonlinear control systems. Reinforcement learning is the best technique to use when trying to regulate a complicated nonlinear system since it allows a system to learn via experimentation and adapt to a changing environment. Machine learning's reinforcement learning subfield examines how agents should respond and behave in a given environment in order to maximize some idea of cumulative reward. Learning can be founded on a few types of evaluative criticism. Standard Regulated learning strategies require a preparation set of information comprising of information vectors and comparing wanted yield vectors, i.e., all in all, they require an administrative framework. Such strategies can't be applied to assignments for which the ideal result of the framework isn't known. These assignments can be tackled utilizing different Support learning calculations. On the off chance that the ideal result isn't accessible, the presentation of the framework should be assessed in a roundabout way by considering the impact of its result on the climate with which the framework connects. Support learning strategies can be applied when this impact is estimated by changes in an assessment sign, or support. For such systems having continuous state spaces, DDPG and SAC are two of the most widely used algorithms. An inverted pendulum is mimicked as a control task fully intent on figuring out how to offset the pendulum with no earlier information on the elements, utilizing Support learning. In the following paper we will compare the two algorithms and verify which is better. For demonstration purposes, both the algorithms are implemented on inverted pendulum problem. The results show that the potential of SAC to contribute to reinforcement learning and control is significant. It also outperforms the DDPG in complex control problems.

articleTitle: Signal Space Diversity Based Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access System Employing $M$-Ary PSK
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The power domain non-orthogonal multiple access (PD-NOMA) performs reasonably well under perfect successive interference cancellation (SIC) conditions. However, under imperfect SIC, the average sum rate (ASR) and outage performance of PD-NOMA diminish drastically. This work introduces a new signal space diversity (SSD) based PD-NOMA system to mitigate this sudden decrease in performance. In the proposed system, users' information will be multiplexed in the in-phase and quadrature parts of the rotated constellation points of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$M$</tex>-ary phase-shift keying (PSK) modulation symbol. The proposed system is capable of circumventing the necessity of SICs, leading to no power allocation constraints and reducing the complexity and delay at the receiver. The ASR and outage probability (OP) analytical expressions are evaluated under the Nakagami-m fading channel. It is noticed from the analysis that the proposed system is superior to the PD-NOMA system under imperfect SIC and exhibits comparable performance with that under perfect SIC. Furthermore, the analytical expressions for symbol error rate (SER) and average SER (ASER) are determined for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$M$</tex>-ary PSK modulation scheme, and the optimal angle that minimizes the SER is determined for any value of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$M$</tex>.

articleTitle: Diagnosis Support Model for Autism Spectrum Disorder Using Neuroimaging Data and Xception
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder is a neurodevelopmental disease-causing significant problem in social and behavioral interactions. Diagnosis of Autism is still challenging for the living community because there is no specific blood test or medical test for its detection. Medical personnel has to diagnose it by checking the individual's past social and physical behavior. In this current scenario, using advanced technological methods like deep learning for the detection of autism will help in solving the problem. It will save a lot of individuals in the early stage. Moreover, brain imaging data for this classification will also help acquire more detection features. This study aims to predict autism using brain scans using a transfer learning algorithm that involves a deep Conv net named Xception. The ABIDE I dataset extracts resting-state functional MRI scans for this study. The dataset consists of brain scans for individuals whose ages lie in the range of 7–64 years, which makes the median age of individuals 14.6 years. The transfer learning approach is used for this classification problem, which uses a deep convolution neural network. The xception algorithm is built on the given dataset for the prediction of autism. This study yielded an accuracy of 97.66% on model training whereas achieved an accuracy of 99.39% on the validation of the model. The Xception transfer learning model gives an accuracy score of 67.35% on the testing of the respective model. All results were obtained from neuroimaging data from the resting state. This paper shows that it is feasible to forecast autism at an early stage using advanced computer algorithms. With the help of the study results, we can conclude that the Xception transfer learning model performed better for the diagnosis of autism.

articleTitle: Study on Intelligent Hierarchical Security Framework for VANETS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Vehicles are being added to new vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs). They create “Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)” & platforms that enable interaction among road entities, encourage the development of innovative applications, as well as promote traffic safety services. Attackers can take advantage of the difficult security setup of VANETs. Strong authentication, entity interaction privacy, and anonymity are all emphasized in this project. A V ANET Machine Learning (ML) algorithm-based Intelligent Hierarchical Security Framework for threat identification is the secondary objective. Both are accomplished by this effort. Public vehicle communications datasets are used by this system to train and verify machine learning algorithms. These datasets were used to train and test the ML algorithms in this framework. Assaults can be found by the “proposed Intrusion Detection System (IDS)” even when the FPR is low. Numerous hierarchical algorithms may be advantageous to the framework, according to the statistics. At lower levels, quick and light processing might be advantageous, but accuracy would suffer. Higher-level hierarchical nodes require algorithms that are more precise, accurate, and advanced

articleTitle: Categorization of IRIS Flower Using Different Machine Learning Strategies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Today, machine learning is important in many areas, including agriculture, computer science, healthcare, and medicine, to name a few. It is known that our planet is abundant in species and millions of biomes thrive in the Earth's ecosystem. Some of them share physical characteristics such as size, shape, and color. It is quite difficult for a general human being to determine which items are of which sort. Similarly, it is difficult to determine which flower is of which subspecies in flower species. Classification is the most essential machine learning approach for distinguishing one item from another. Setosa, Versicolor, and Virginica are the three subspecies of the Iris flower. Five approaches are presented in depth, including Decision tree, Naive Bayes, Linear Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-nearest neighbor, and Logistic regression, and the implementation is done using the sci-kit learn the tool. Furthermore, different sizes of training and testing sets are applied to and compared with each method. The IRIS dataset was analyzed using classification and regression algorithms with a 10-fold cross-validation score. The emphasis was on examining patterns utilizing the flower's sepal and petal sizes. In terms of accuracy, the findings showed that the Linear SVM classifier outperformed with 99.17% Model accuracy and 100% of Test accuracy as compared to the Decision tree, Naive Bayes, K-nearest neighbor, and Logistic regression models.

articleTitle: Finding Most Influential Places Using AR, VPS, Game Theory and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Nowadays, navigation systems play an important role in real-life scenarios. Finding the most influential place in a locality can be a complex and cumbersome task. It involves various factors such as, the sort of outdoor location, age range (toddlers, teens, middle-aged, and elderly), approximate population size, and gender diversity. In this paper, we propose a model to obtain the top-k most influential places. The proposed model is classified into two folds: finding information about location based on image classification and finding top K place information based on game theory. In the first fold, we used the R-CNN + EfficientNet models for image classification. In the second fold, we have used the Shapley value (a game theoretic approach) for finding the top K place selection. Now we have introduced the visual positioning system (VPS) to find accurate navigation to particular places.

articleTitle: A Review of Diverse Machine Learning Algorithms for Spam E-Mail and Text Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Mostly everything in this formal world is communicated mainly with the help of emails. But nowadays looking at growing popularity of emails, the amount of uninvited data such as spam emails, advertisements etc has also increased. To overcome this problem there are pre-existing techniques of data filtering and various algorithms in ML/DL which are capable of classifying and automatically detecting these types of unwanted spams. This paper does a survey on the research carried out in the domain of machine learning and deep learning techniques, data pre-processing, feature extraction and optimization methods over the years to improve overall performance of algorithms for filtering of these unwanted emails.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection Using SEResNeXt and Swin Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: In this work, we intend to device a methodology to solve the issue of Medical Image Classification on cancer patients using Deep Learning techniques. According to the World World Health Organization, the most common occurring cancer globally is breast cancer. In the year 2020, 2.3 million new breast cancer cases have been diagnosed. Due to this nearly 685,000 individuals died. From the 1980s regular checkup in mammography screening had been proposed by the health authorities which resulted in a 40 % reduction in several countries. At the moment, beginning stages of breast cancer can be detected using mammography specialized radiologists. In the past few years it has been reported that, there is a shortage among radiologists in several nations. This process could be automated using Deep Learning techniques, which would reduce the number of human-made errors and amount of time taken to inspect the MRI scan. Henceforth, in the work using feature vectors from SEResNeXt and applying Attention mechanism over these vectors to efficiently and accurately classify the MRI scans and we have obtained a probabilistic F1 score of 0.61 and an accuracy of 0.96.

articleTitle: Proficient Dazzling Crow Optimization Routing Protocol (PDCORP) for Effective Energy Administration in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Routing in Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) is the most complicated and challenging process because of the non-static and random behaviour of the network. WSNs are the collection of sensing devices to sense the changes that occur in the deployed environment. These environment-less networks meet many challenges that must be identified and rectified to guarantee their effective deployment. Routing is among them, and they determine how data is to be transmitted between network nodes. Efficient routing algorithms must be designed to adapt to network topology changes. This Paper proposes the bio-inspired optimization-based routing protocol, namely Proficient Dazzling Crow Optimization Routing Protocol (PDCORP), for effective data transmission by selecting the best route. The distinct behaviour of the most interesting and intelligent bird crow, is the inspiration to design the methodology of this routing protocol. This results in a remarkable packet delivery ratio, throughput, latency, and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Medical Dataset Preparation and Privacy Preservation for Improving the Healthcare Facilities Using Federated Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: As a result of recent advances in deep learning, several breakthrough stories in modern medical diagnostics with data-driven insights into improving healthcare facilities' quality of treatment have arisen. Deep learning methods that perform well are significantly data-driven. As more data is trained, the deep learning model's performance becomes much more robust and generalizable. On the other hand, collecting medical data in a central storage system to train effective deep learning models raises concerns about privacy, ownership, and regulatory compliance. Federated learning overcomes the previous difficulties by using a deep learning model which is shared and a centralized aggregating platform. On the other side, patient data resides with the local party, assuring data confidentiality and data security. First, we give a comprehensive, up-to-date survey of federated learning research in healthcare applications. Next, we propose a solution for preparation of the medical dataset for federated learning approach from publicly available medical repositories and then apply federated averaging(FedAvg) and FedProx algorithm for aggregating across clients without accessing local private data.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Aided Spectrum Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Spectrum sensing (SS) is a key concept that determines the effectiveness of cognitive radio (CR). Although multiple sensing practices have been proposed in the literature, out of them energy detector (ED) have been widely adopted. However, the performance of ED relies on pre-existing knowledge of noise distribution and threshold. Therefore, efficient spectrum sensing remains a challenge in wireless communication technologies. This paper aims to analyze the sensing performance of various machine learning (ML) models in different fading scenarios. We carefully model a spectrum sensing environment and generate a large-scale comprehensive dataset. We then train and test several well-established classical and ML techniques for spectrum sensing. The performance of classical spectrum sensing and ML-based spectrum sensing are compared under various parameters like the number of secondary user (SU), the distance between primary user (PU) and SU; and different fading environments such as Rayleigh, Rician, and Nakagami. The Simulation result shows that machine learning models outperform classical sensing techniques. Furthermore, it is found that support vector machine (SVM) outperformed other ML techniques in predicting channel availability.

articleTitle: A UAV Based Sound Acquisition System for Acoustic Monitoring of Birds
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles are being increasingly used in ecological research and environmental science, in particular to approach sensitive wildlife within inaccessible areas. More specifically with relation to birds that generally reside in trees or away from populated areas. Bioacoustic monitoring via UAV mounted recorders could be a significant new technique for monitoring songbird populations and the environment that they predominantly reside. The intention is to build a low-cost aerial system, that is capable of acquiring Bird call data. This paper outlines the analysis of different microphone types and their impact on reducing UAV noise during in-flight testing. One small UAV system is presented with a suspended microphone system used for the application of monitoring wildlife, specifically birds. Bird call audio data is successfully captured in the real environment at high altitude. Providing validation that this system can be used for acquiring bird call data for further bird species detection analysis.

articleTitle: Unraveling the Landscape of Bitcoin Research Using Machine Learning: A Topic Modelling Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This study provides a comprehensive analysis of the evolving field of Bitcoin research through the application of bibliometric analysis and structural topic modeling techniques. A dataset of 1,937 articles from the Scopus database, spanning the period between 2013 and 2023, was examined, with a specific focus on the prominent digital currency, Bitcoin. The analysis encompasses publication trends, influential journals, authors, institutions, and impactful articles in the field. Through the application of structural topic modeling, six distinct thematic clusters in Bitcoin research are identified, encompassing topics such as blockchain-based digital currency, volatility modeling, portfolio diversification, Bitcoin futures trading, return forecasting, and cryptocurrency regulations. Furthermore, this study outlines future research directions in the domains of finance, economics, and management pertaining to Bitcoin. By bridging the gap in existing literature and providing valuable insights, this study aims to support the development of effective risk management strategies, regulatory frameworks, and business approaches. The findings serve as a valuable resource for industry practitioners, academics, regulators, and policymakers navigating the evolving landscape of cryptocurrencies.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Heart Disease Classification Techniques Utilizing ECG Signal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Heart disease(HD), poses a global threat to human life. Despite its utmost significance, finding solutions for this issue remains challenging. One effective approach is the early and accurate identification of abnormal cardiac signals, which plays a vital role in diagnosing heart problems and preventing catastrophic outcomes. Healthcare professionals employ the Electrocardiogram (ECG) as a tool to evaluate heart-related electrical activity. By carefully analyzing ECG patterns, they can anticipate conditions like arrhythmia and congestive heart failure. This paper presents an in-depth review of cutting-edge techniques employed in ECG-based heart disease classification, meticulously evaluating the performance of various classification algorithms, including support vector machines, random forests, neural networks, and ensemble methods, in effectively identifying heart diseases from ECG data, this study aspires to serve as an indispensable resource for researchers, clinicians, and healthcare professionals alike. Through its comprehensive overview, the review strives to engender a profound understanding of the current state-of-the-art techniques, elucidating their inherent strengths, and limitations, and also explores the potential of ensemble learning methods for enhancing classification accuracy through model combination. These findings contribute to a better understanding of different models.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Optimal Automated Teller Machine Site Selection Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Study on Variables, Challenges, and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The proliferation of Automated Teller Machines (ATMs) in the banking sector has raised the stakes in identifying the most suitable locations for these machines, given their impact on the profitability and satisfaction of bank clients. This study presents a comprehensive examination of the variables that influence ATM placement, exploring the significance of identifying an optimal location and the challenges associated with this task. Our investigation pivots on market-centric variables such as the proximity of eateries, fuel stations, that are ubiquitously available in the public domain. To establish this benchmark, a dataset that remains singularly unique and is conspicuously absent from publicly accessible Internet repositories is created. Our innovative approach encompasses the application of multiple machine learning models to analyze the performance using unprecedented dataset. This study also focuses on ranking the market factors that we used in the novel dataset to study what market variables affect the location of an ATM along with resolving the limitations and challenges.

articleTitle: Quantum Gateway Security with Fault Tolerance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: The quantum communications is a far distant theoretical concept that has been taken up in many developing nations, to practically actualize it in daily activities. This has its own caveat which cannot be left unhindered. Networking with optical communication and controlling entangled-photons are areas that needs to be bridged with the assistance of quantum mechanics and physics of information theory. A quantum network test bed with existing quantum devices in real life network environment is being studied at NIST since a decade. This work highlights a part of the network gateway, that can assist in communicating over long channels and geographies, considering the loss of information in terms of qubits on the go. This work presents a concept to enhance secure exchange of information, in a faulty channel, and attempts to make the communication resilient to loss of qubits, following existing architecture.

articleTitle: VLSI Architecture for Low Complexity Zero Forcing Equalizer in OTFS Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) is a promising modulation technique that provides enhanced resilience to time-varying channels, making it suitable for high-mobility scenarios. In this work, we focus on achieving a low-complexity hardware implementation of the zero forcing (ZF) Equalizer for single-input-single-output (SISO) OTFS system. The proposed very large scale integration (VLSI) architecture leverages parallel processing and resource optimization techniques to reduce the computational complexity and hardware requirements of the ZF equalizer. We use the back-to-back connection of fast Fourier transform (FFT) and inverse fast Fourier transform (IFFT) that simplify matrix inversions [1] and it updates without significantly compromising performance. By carefully designing the architecture, we aim to achieve real-time processing capability while meeting are requirements and latency constraints. Through extensive simulations and performance evaluations, we analyze the trade-offs between complexity reduction and equalization performance. Metrics such as bit error rate (BER), latency and area are considered to assess the efficiency and effectiveness of the proposed architecture. We observe from the synthesis results on the 7vx485tffg1157-1 FPGA device that the architecture achieves 440ns latency with 100MHz clock frequency, 249, 843 lookup tables (LUTs) and 74, 611 flip-flops (FF).

articleTitle: A Study on Integration of Trust Management and Application Placement in Fog Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: Fog computing enables placement of applications on fog nodes present in the proximity of Internet of Things (IoT) users, leading to improved performance such as fast response time, low bandwidth consumption, low power consumption, etc. Thus, IoT users experienced enhanced satisfaction. Quality of Experience (QoE) is a well-known metric used to meter the user satisfaction level and can be enhanced with improvement in the performance of IoT applications. However, application placement in presence of malicious fog environment can lead to numerous harmful effects such as inaccurate placement results, reduced user satisfaction, and increased user relinquish rate. Thus, we integrate a trust management framework in QoE-aware application placement framework to study the effect of trust in reducing the harmful effects created in malicious environment. The trust management framework evaluates and manages the trust of fog nodes and consider them with other QoE-dependent metrics to make placement decisions. Simulation results show that our proposed placement mechanism performs satisfactorily in malicious fog environments.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Techniques for Workload Prediction in Serverless Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach for predicting serverless workloads using machine learning techniques. The research highlights the importance of accurate workload prediction in serverless computing and provides valuable insights into the potential benefits of machine learning in this context. The proposed approach utilises machine learning models to analyse historical data on serverless workloads and various features related to system behaviour to identify patterns and trends and predict the expected resource requirements for future serverless workloads. The study includes multiple machine-learning techniques such as LSTM, ARIMA and VAR and time-series analysis to accurately predict workload patterns and resource demands to determine which is best suited for predicting serverless workloads. The performance evaluation uses real-world serverless workload data, demonstrating its effectiveness in accurately predicting resource needs and optimising resource allocation. This research's findings could improve the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of serverless computing by enabling proactive resource allocation and optimisation.

articleTitle: Unlocking ALS Insights with the Power of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Electrical, Electronics, Communication and Computers (ELEXCOM)
abstract: ALS or Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis is a rare neurological disease, affecting the motor neurons, or in lay man terms, voluntary movements at first, degenerating over time, and ultimately any or all remaining muscles of a human body. Early official descriptions of this disease leads back to circa 1824, ultimately being termed as such in 1874 by French neurologist, Jean-Martin Charcot. As of today, the exact and particular cause of this disease is not known, but, it has been argued that this disease occurs due to mutations in specific genetics, otherwise labelled as “sporadic” in nature. Since, voluntary muscle movements degenerate, or simply die, usually starts with difficulty or confusion in thinking over specific topics at hand. Over time, speaking, swallowing, and chewing abilities are lost by the patient, it has been widely accepted that there is need for mechanical, or “smart” enough device companions for the patients to ease their communication while they suffer. Most famous example would be the British physicist, Stephen Hawking, accompanied by a speech generating device ever since he lost his speech.
